criteria.passage: I wouldn’t spend much time trying to reproduce it without steps.
criteria.rationale: The candidate explicitly says they would not spend much time trying to reproduce the issue, which materially contradicts establishing how to reproduce or characterise the failure.

The answer mentions checking whether the search service was up and considering the absence of a broader outage, but it does not clearly compare failing conditions with known working behaviour of the search page.
The response gives only a very high-level check and a conclusion to treat it as a one-off; it does not show a systematic process of using observations to narrow plausible causes.

annotation.annotation_notes: The candidate shows some initial triage but does not substantively demonstrate reproduction, comparative diagnosis, or systematic narrowing.
